objective: Execute on 120–170 additional samplers, rejecting any that violate the Math/Program logic split; preserve elegance and beauty.
completion_policy: Assess every promising candidate. The minimum is not permission to leave viable assigned candidates unfinished. Count only independently accepted named sampler specifications; identify derived cases separately; do not count deterministic helpers or selectors.
